grounding.excerpt: The limits begin on the effective date of this permit and lasting through 3 years from the permit effective date.

The limits apply during the period beginning 3 year from the permit effective date and lasting through the expiration date of the permit and any time during which the permit is administratively continued if not reissued prior to expiration.
The permittee shall achieve compliance with the TDS net increase effluent concentration limit of 449 mg/L 3 years after the permit effective date.
Complete constructions and cease discharging backwash waste of WTP#2 to the City's WWTP — December 2027

payload.rationale: The packet shows parallel temporal language (three years from the permit effective date) and the same numeric limit (449 mg/L TDS net increase) in both footnote *11 and Section B.2, and footnotes *10/*11 define calendar-based table limit applicability windows. However, the packet does not state the permit effective date, so the relationship between Federal FY2025 monitoring periods and the three-year transition cannot be established. Section B.2 uses outcome-oriented 'achieve compliance' language and lists supporting construction activities extending to December 2027, which leaves open whether enforceable limit applicability follows the table footnote calendar (*11) or actual achievement on the compliance schedule. The packet does not explicitly cross-reference Section B.2 with footnotes *10/*11 or resolve whether interim 497 mg/L enforceability persists until compliance is achieved. Neither ACCEPT (same transition point) nor REJECT (achievement-deferred enforceability with interim 497 mg/L) can be grounded from this evidence alone; unsupported semantic closure is avoided.
